1.0.2: Added output examples to component schemas.
2.0.0: (breaking change) MakeApiCall: headers and parameters changed to key-value array inputs (body remains textarea/JSON to support nested structures) per standard #1459 — existing flows that used the old string/textarea headers or parameters must be updated
2.1.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to all triggers: NewDatabaseItem, UpdatedDatabaseItem.
2.1.1: Added missing output examples to CreateDatabaseItem, NewDatabaseItem, UpdateDatabaseItem and UpdatedDatabaseItem. Their `cover` and `icon` outputs are now declared as an object or null, which is what Notion returns (they were declared as strings).
2.1.2: CreatePage, GetDatabase and GetPage now stop with a clear error when a required input is missing instead of calling the API; added output examples, and GetPage cover / icon and GetDatabase cover are now declared as objects, which is what Notion returns.
2.2.0: New component List Pages: lists the pages shared with the integration (up to 100, most recently edited first), with the standard Output Type options.
CreatePage: the parent page can now be picked from a dropdown that shows each page with its path (Parent / Subpage, Database / Item); entering a Page ID still works.
MakeApiCall: only calls the Notion API (https://api.notion.com). A URL on any other host is rejected, because the request carries the account's token.

UpdatedDatabaseItem: no longer misses an item edited in the same minute as the previously reported one (Notion rounds edit times to the minute). NewDatabaseItem: an old row is no longer reported as new when a newer row is deleted from a database with more than 100 rows.

UpdateDatabaseItem: Content now updates a page that starts with a heading (it failed after the properties were already saved) and is added as a new paragraph to a page without a text block (it was dropped). The Item ID input accepts a typed or mapped ID.

CreateDatabaseItem, UpdateDatabaseItem: a checkbox mapped from the text "false" is no longer set to true; an empty number is left alone and a non-numeric one is rejected; several file URLs can be separated by commas.

FindDatabaseItem: stops with a clear error when a filtered property was renamed or removed in Notion. FindPageByTitle: requires a title, returns the whole title of a page (not only its first fragment) and writes a well-formed CSV.
Database, item and user dropdowns and the generated inspectors are cached for two minutes and no longer show an error popup when Notion is unavailable.
